title: LED troffer, offices
summary: We need more information about the LED's rated life, color consistency, and DLC qualification before we can approve this fixture. The main problem is that the specific model you submitted has been discontinued by the manufacturer and can no longer be sourced.

findings.title: Rated life (L70) not verified
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed long-life performance, we risk frequent lamp replacements and higher maintenance costs down the line.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

findings.title: DLC listing not verified
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing DLC qualification could mean ineligibility for utility rebates and may not meet project energy efficiency goals.

findings.title: MacAdam ellipse binning not verified
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: LEDs outside the specified color tolerance could create noticeable color differences between fixtures, affecting the quality of light in the office spaces.

findings.title: Dims down to
findings.detail: Package states 0.1 %; spec requires at most 5 %.
